name: Coda (Superhuman Docs)
one_liner: Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda), a document platform with a REST API for docs, tables, and rows.
auth_notes: Bearer API token in Authorization header; actions bound to token owner's workspace role.
access_notes: API is free in free and paid workspaces; createDoc needs Doc Maker/Admin role.

buildability.rationale: Free self-serve bearer token, documented REST API and rate limits. Only inbound webhook-triggered automation found, no outbound event subscriptions seen; MCP server URL not located.

access.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.

api_surface.quote: Reading data (with the exceptions below): 100 requests per 6 seconds

mcp.quote: you may also want to consider using the Superhuman Docs MCP server.

buildability.quote: the owner of the API token must be a Doc Maker (or Admin) in the workspace.

identity.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users

disputes.why: Docs mention a Superhuman Docs MCP server but no URL or vendor-hosting evidence; official unconfirmed, confidence low.
